description: Plan a visit route through buildings of Pierre-Jean Tribot's architecture entity base (Baltic states and Finland). Select buildings by architect, city, collection (theme) and/or era, or give explicit ids; returns them ordered by proximity (nearest-neighbour from a start point) with as-the-crow-flies distances, links to each record, and any matching editorial route (e.g. 'Aalto in Finland'). Use it for itinerary questions: 'a day of architecture in Riga', 'Aalto houses route', 'Soviet modernism walk in Vilnius'.

architect.description: Architect or practice name (partial match), e.g. 'Aalto', 'Laube'

city.description: City of the base (Tallinn, Riga, Vilnius, Helsinki, Tartu, Kaunas, Tampere, Pärnu); includes nearby places attached to it

start.description: Start point: a building id, or 'lat,lon'. Default: the most central selected building

within_city_only.description: Exclude nearby places outside the city itself (default false)

name: plan_architecture_route
